items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: p0seid0n design tokens: the nine --p0seid0n-* colours, control and panel radii, popup shadow, and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline bridge.
items.docs: Import the stylesheet once, in the same file that imports Tailwind. Light and dark follow color-scheme: the OS preference by default, or a .light or .dark class on the html element. There are no dark: variants, so overriding any --p0seid0n-* value re-themes every component, including at runtime.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn() class merge helper built on clsx and tailwind-merge.
items.docs: Import cn from your lib alias. It merges conditional classes with clsx and resolves Tailwind conflicts with tailwind-merge.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Ink-filled primary, control-grey secondary, transparent ghost and danger button in three sizes, with loading and leading/trailing slots.
items.docs: Use variant primary, secondary, ghost or danger and size sm, md or lg. Loading sets aria-busy, disables interaction and leaves the progress slot usable. Use the leading and trailing slots for icons; the component ships none. A click handler passed from the parent is not called while loading or disabled.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small labelling chip in neutral, accent, accent-alt and outline variants.
items.docs: Pick a variant with the variant prop. Text stays at the smallest type step so a badge never competes with the value it labels.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: One-pixel rule in a line colour, horizontal or vertical.
items.docs: Set orientation to vertical inside a flex row; the rule stretches to the container height. It is decorative by default and hidden from assistive tech; set decorative to false to expose a separator role.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Panel container with a raised or surface appearance, plus header, content and footer sections.
items.docs: The panel radius is 16px and the border uses the line colour. appearance raised is the default for cards on the page background; use surface for panels nested inside a raised container. CardHeader takes title, description and action slots, and its default slot fills the title.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field with a focus ring, an aria-driven invalid state and a disabled state.
items.docs: Bind with v-model. Set invalid to render aria-invalid and the danger border. Give it an id and point a Label at the same value so the two stay associated.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Caption that associates with a control through its for attribute, with an optional required marker.
items.docs: Pass for with the id of the control. required appends a decorative asterisk in the danger colour; it is hidden from assistive tech, so keep the native required or aria-required attribute on the control itself.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Two-state control built on reka-ui, in md and lg sizes with an optional slot inside the thumb.
items.docs: Bind with v-model. Space and Enter toggle it and aria-checked follows the value. The thumb slot is empty by default so an icon can be passed without adding a dependency. Transitions are dropped under prefers-reduced-motion.
